meta.name: vp-cpo-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Guide the transition to VP or CPO across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when executive product scope is changing fast.

copy.tagline: 指导从准备到入职的VP/CPO转型全过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从产品总监向VP或CPO跃迁
copy.tagline_en: Guide your transition to VP or CPO from preparation to landing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from product director to VP or CPO

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过提问诊断你处于从总监到副总裁/CPO 的哪个阶段（准备、面试、刚上任或调整），然后给出针对性的建议和框架。
howto.when: 当你提到正在向副总裁或 CPO 职位过渡，或者面临高管产品角色变化时触发。

say.text: 我正在准备从总监晋升到副总裁，帮我规划一下。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的发展领域并给出建议。

say.text: 我收到了一个 CPO 的 offer，帮我评估一下。
say.note: Claude 会引导你分析 CEO 面试问题等。

say.text: 我刚上任 VP 六个月，和同级高管合作不顺利。
say.note: Claude 会诊断问题并提供调整建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude diagnoses which of four transition stages you are in (preparing, interviewing, newly landed, or recalibrating) and delivers targeted coaching using frameworks like the Three Ps and Empowerment Myth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention transitioning to VP or CPO, or when executive product scope is changing fast.

say_en.text: I'm preparing to move from Director to VP. Help me plan.
say_en.note: Claude asks about your development area and gives advice.

say_en.text: I have a CPO offer. Help me evaluate it.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through CEO interview questions.

say_en.text: I've been VP for six months and peer relationships aren't working.
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses and offers recalibration steps.
